text:
Priya (CSM): Kicking off AlderCare onboarding — quick sync so we all agree on owners, success criteria, and a lightweight timeline. Alex from AlderCare is on this thread to confirm availability.

Alex (AlderCare): Thanks Priya — hi everyone. Main goals: integrate Redwood API for triage summaries, keep latency under 300ms for 95th pct, and full data isolation for PHI. We can do weekday afternoons for calls.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Noted on latency + PHI. I'll own the initial test harness and a perf-run. Need to know expected RPS and sample payload sizes. Alex, can you share concurrency and avg token lengths?

Alex (AlderCare): We expect ~5rps steady, spikes to 20rps during shift changes. Typical prompt ~500 tokens, responses ~250 tokens.

Jordan (Eng): Thanks — from infra side we recommend starting with a Dedicated small pool (2 GPUs) for the pilot, then scale up if perf SLOs fail. Tentative timeline:
- Week 0: onboarding + infra provision
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests
- Week 2: perf run + canary
- Week 3: handover to support
We can compress if sample load is low.

Mina (Enablement): I'll schedule two enablement sessions for AlderCare devs: API quickstart (30m) and prompt engineering + safety (45m). Preferred dates? Also will capture feedback in a short form post-training.

Priya (CSM): Owners recap: Priya (overall CSM), Sam (integration + test harness), Jordan (infra + scaling), Mina (enablement). Alex is customer lead. Success criteria (what we need to agree on today):
- Integration working end-to-end with test suite passing
- 95th percentile latency < 300ms on pilot loads
- Data handling & audit logs verified for PHI compliance
- Training delivered and feedback collected (NPS >= 7)
If anyone wants to add/change, reply here.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Added checklist snippet for the integration test (posting here so it's easy to copy):
```
# integration_checklist.sh (pseudo)
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @sample.json
2) run smoke assertions (status == 200, tokens < 2000)
3) KV-cache hit rate report
4) run 5m perf with k6 (5rps -> spike 20rps)
```

Jordan (Eng): I'll provision the Dedicated pool tomorrow and share the access + region. If we hit perf regressions, fallback plan = route to hosted API fallback with rate-limited queueing for non-PHI traffic.

deploy-bot: Workspace "aldercare-pilot" created by Jordan — resources: dev-gw, dedicated-pool-2g, logs-retention=90d.

Alex (AlderCare): Perfect. We'll aim to provide a sample dataset and the dev token by Monday. Afternoon sessions work for us — prefer Wed/Thu.

Mina (Enablement): I'll book Wed 2pm PT for API quickstart and Thu 11am PT for prompt + safety. Calendar invites incoming.

Priya (CSM): Great — next check-in Friday EOD for readiness status. I'll post a one-pager with success criteria + escalation contacts. :thumbsup:

Sam (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. I'll start the harness and ping when first smoke run is green. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Eng): Will confirm region + pool details in the channel once provisioned.

Priya (CSM): Thanks everyone — tagging owners: @Sam, @Jordan, @Mina, @Alex. We'll keep updates here so it's easy to trace.

Alex (AlderCare): Thanks all — excited to get started! :party:
__note: This document is a single Slack thread; messages are in chronological order as a single string. No title field per agents.md requirements.
